# SnagOtter

> A free video and audio downloader. Paste a link from YouTube, Instagram (Reels, posts), TikTok, Facebook, X or another site supported by yt-dlp, pick the quality, and save it. No sign-up, no ads, no tracking. Made by Aahil Riyaz Beekay.

- App: https://snagotter.vercel.app/
- Source: https://github.com/Aahil-Riyaz/snagotter
- API: POST /api/info {url}, POST /api/jobs, GET /api/jobs/{id}/events (SSE), GET /api/jobs/{id}/file.
- Only download content you have the right to use.
